name: pen-sync
description: Keep a pen.dev (Pencil) design-system file in step with a React component library: Storybook variant matrices pushed through the pen.dev CLI, polished against the code, and design edits diffed back into code.
author: Jeff Hodges (https://github.com/jhodges10)

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/lz-string/libs/lz-string.min.js vendor/lz-string.min.cjs && bun build node_modules/pngjs/lib/png.js --target=node --format=esm --minify --outfile vendor/pngjs.mjs
